exposure: Source-informed questions authored after reading the six scientific documents and completing the owner mathematical reconstruction. S09 uses actual previous repository context and is an exposed correction regression. None is held out. No ranking/model/ontology changes or query-specific aliases are included.

cases.query: In the reflected hopping model,connecting each memory only to its own rail killed the conditional interaction. Can a local positive spring network retain counterrotating terms and give a provably nonzero own-rail interaction? What change in low-frequency access is being paid?

When a dressed interacting pair emits an external photon,I need the distribution over every residual state,including the scattering continuum. How can I get it from complete one-particle spectral data without replacing the final state by two dressed memory modes?

My mirror-preserving shield eliminates every one-external-photon emission term,not just the bare transition frequency. Is that enough for an exact protected pair,or can a higher channel survive? I need an actual support construction.

Each module has a simple eigenstate separated from its own allowed spectrum,but its same symmetry sector has energies both below and above that state. What decides whether arbitrarily many replicas retain a uniform rank-one target gap?

A replica-stability argument asks for a uniform perturbation budget. Every pairwise spectator interaction in my architecture becomes weak as the system grows. Can that replace a bound on the total operator norm? Give a concrete failure if it cannot.

I have a non-number-conserving oscillator-spin model protected only by excitation parity. May I use a two-excitation external-band sumset gap as its exact protection certificate when the physical external field is gapless?
unavailable: positive minimum frequency of every external mode

cases.query: I can perturb analytically from a bare vacuum,and each vertex changes photon number by one. How do I justify four unbounded creation operators on the dressed state before a replica-spectrum argument? Does that also give a rate for a local density coupler?

For the same local controlled-phase task,does global continuum embedding help against an ordinary one-accessible-band design when total leading coupling,dressing and exchange are matched? I also care about static memory imbalance.

An earlier memory-detuning note says local continuation was not proved there. Is there now a supported ordered detuning pole route,and is the quoted0.036114365 coefficient a population linewidth or an amplitude linewidth?
